name: Worktree
description: Run a coding task in a separate Git checkout and review its native conversation.
author: Modera
agentGuidance: Worktree mode is configured by the user through the composer environment switch. Task isolation is allocated implicitly by the host and plugin when a new conversation is sent. Never insert worktree setup instructions into the user draft. The worktree_draft tool is for an explicit request to save a task draft only.

tools.title: Draft a worktree task
tools.description: Save a reviewable coding task for an isolated Git worktree. It does not start execution.

zh-CN.name: 工作树
zh-CN.description: 在独立的 Git 工作目录中运行代码任务。
